briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 and xAI Colossus-3 push frontier capabilities as compute bottlenecks tighten

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases while governments debate export controls on advanced chips. Funding remains robust with multiple $1B+ rounds closed this quarter. Multi-agent security protocols gain traction amid rising attack surfaces.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys Orion-2 with improved reasoning chains; Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus; Google DeepMind tests Gemini 3 Ultra; xAI launches Colossus-3; DeepSeek unveils V4 with strong coding benchmarks. Meta open-sources Llama 4.1 weights under new license.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines emphasize runtime verification for autonomous agents.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 2nm production for AI accelerators; Microsoft and Oracle announce joint 50GW data center expansion; NVIDIA Blackwell supply constraints persist into Q4.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI-level system emerge from a US lab or a Chinese consortium by 2028?
